Dragging any selected Arrangement clip moves the complete Audio/MIDI selection using one anchor, shared zero bound and one canonical prepared transaction/Undo. Selected originals survive overlapping copies while unselected destinations still overwrite. Invalid lanes, insertion, vertical autoscroll, stale source/selection or cancellation hide all previews and refuse partial release.

Pointer updates now reuse an opaque drag-owned capture bound to the actual immutable Project allocation by Weak identity. Metadata and musical placement shells are captured once; updates project original coordinates into retained storage without whole-project scans or metadata allocation. Group waveform rendering resolves originals by checked captured indices. All existing generation/revision/selection/pending/release checks remain, and retirement clears capture inside the shared GPUI payload. Cached clips never become commit authority.

Frozen source72bebf44f5c050cc19d106ddd6bcb3b5be27c386/treeed69c739b4cfa2c1b642013997de43f5fd46c347; canonical22bc and minimal repairdcd1 history preserved. Review returns copy-overlap, stale previews, per-pointer/per-member scans and todo evidence addressed. Five actual original REDs are archived separately from corrected source. No Engine/Session/schema changes.

Validation:109 runtime PASS (96Project,10group GPUI,3legacy single-drag GPUI),3privacy compile-fails PASS, strict all-target Project/UI Clippy, formatting and five guards PASS. Source-bound counting harness measures zero metadata/backing allocation/free after capture for frame and musical previews through16384 clips. Actual GPUI redraw is measured separately; debug/instrumented timings are not native deadline or whole-paint O(selected) claims.

Immutable evidence-only commit512ed15c on evidence/source4-sampler-cloud-20261018, folder evidence/group-409/72bebf44-capture. Archive288867B SHA2560f028a3f58faf2f11ecbe76396255a1d261df6beb00361fb4dd6b4e05f4c9196;78payloads/manifest10b5700fb6f09b6c854363f63295bf655400ac0ba3864779bcf72e1ab9a93754. Includes exact source patches/files, original failures, final logs and finite coordinator-only native request13new/changed runtime+3privacy. Never build/merge evidence refs.

Source-ready handoff to sole merger for required exact prospective-tree CI/review/integration. Compose Source1 Console420 additive Browser destination/deferred cleanup with these capture-retirement calls. No final fullCI/native/physical acceptance or merge claimed. Pulse remains In Progress until actually merged. No app/backend/native/user-data operations.
